A thoughtful start at your kitchen tap.

Your drinking and cooking water may call for a more focused approach. Explore countertop and under-sink reverse osmosis options around your home and your questions.

Schedule a Water Consultation

One point of use. A specific purpose.

A drinking-water system treats water at a particular location, often in the kitchen. It serves a different role from a whole-home system installed at the main water supply.

Florida Pure Solutions’ current product range includes countertop and under-sink reverse osmosis systems. Equipment selection should follow a discussion of your source water, test results, drinking-water needs, and the particular model’s verified capabilities.

Countertop or under the sink?

For a countertop option, think about the available surface area, how water is supplied, and any power requirements of the exact model. For an under-sink option, discuss cabinet space, plumbing access, the drinking-water faucet, and any drain connection.

Do not assume every setup suits every kitchen. Have the proposed equipment and installation reviewed before purchase, including any access or plumbing changes needed.

Plan for the life of the filter.

Reverse osmosis systems may include several filter stages and a membrane, with different maintenance intervals. Use the model’s own instructions rather than a universal replacement timetable.

Ask for model-specific performance information, certification for the concern being addressed, operating requirements, replacement-part availability, and a clear quote. This site does not guarantee removal percentages or offer an installation price.

Three questions to bring along.

  1. Which exact model fits my source water and kitchen space?
  2. What does installation require, including faucet and drain connections?
  3. Which filters and membrane will I replace, and when?

For water used throughout the house, explore a whole-home filtration discussion as well.
